The solvent that delaminates cathode films from aluminum foil "in seconds" without corroding the foil is ethylene glycol (EG). 

According to the Sustainable Direct Recycling of Lithium-Ion Batteries via Solvent Recovery of Electrode Materials paper, at the boiling point of EG (198 °C), delamination takes around 2 seconds.

So, the answer is: ethylene glycol, 2 seconds, 198 °C.
